args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The import used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and FIN-212 require
ROUND_HALF_EVEN, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`.
- This change switches the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the existing docstring and FIN-212.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.

Fixes the nightly build failure.

- **Fixed on a new branch** `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` (commit `08d3cd5986`), switching the quantize rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- **CI passed**: run `ci-0001` on the branch completed successfully.
- **Opened PR #101** against `main` requesting review from alex: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

The PR is now pending review; merging into main will need code-owner approval per policy, so I have not merged it.
